metodos.codigoOriginal:
LParameters _Imp, _OForm, _nPorta

ThisForm.Impressora = _Imp
ThisForm.oFormulario = _oForm
ThisForm.Portaserial = _nPorta
Clear Typeahead
ThisForm.cntSombra.lblSombra.Caption = ThisForm.Caption
ThisForm.cntSombra.lblTitulo.Caption = ThisForm.Caption

Local llOk
ThisForm.Mensagem.Caption = 'Verificando Status'
llOk = .t.
DO Case
	Case  InList(ThisForm.Impressora,'DATAREGIS','NDATAREGIS')
		VerStatus = RotStatus(.t.,ThisForm.oFormulario)
		If Type('VerStatus')<>'L' And Substr(VerStatus,4,1) = 'S'
			llOk = .f.
		Endif
	Case InList(ThisForm.Impressora,'SWEDA','NSWEDA')
		VerStatus = StatGaveta(ThisForm.oFormulario)
		If VerStatus = '0'
			llOk = .f.
		Endif
	Case InList(ThisForm.Impressora,'BEMATECH','BEMA8501','DARUMA','EPSON')
		VerStatus = S... [TRUNCADO]
